findings.location: Paragraph 1 (rendering of “he would crane his neck”)
findings.source_quote: Every Sunday morning, he would crane his neck in search of the hoary head of the fellowship’s oldest member
findings.suggested_fix:
Use an idiomatic Kiswahili verb for 'crane his neck' such as “aning'ama shingo” or “alikuwa akipandisha shingo” or “alikuwa akitikisa shingo kwa kutafuta”. Suggested replacement (preserving

…

): "Kila Jumapili asubuhi, alikibwaga shingo kutafuta kichwa cha mwanachama mzee mwenye nywele za kijivu wa kikundi." or "Kila Jumapili asubuhi, alibana shingo kutafuta kichwa cha mwanachama mzee mwenye nywele za kijivu wa kikundi."
findings.translation_quote: Kila Jumapili asubuhi, algekea shingo kutafuta kichwa cha mwanachama mzee mwenye nywele za kijivu wa kikundi, na kila wakati mama yake angesogeza macho kumtazama Dirk kwa mtazamo ulio maana, “Kaa kimya na tazama mbele.”

findings.location: Paragraph where Dirk uses his sleeve as handkerchief
findings.source_quote: “I’m sorry. I didn’t think about it like that,” Dirk sniveled, using his sleeve as a handkerchief.
findings.suggested_fix:
